description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of ChatGPT compared to VADER and TextBlob in sentiment analysis tasks, as evaluated in the paper “Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis.” The horizontal axis lists the three algorithms — VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT — while the vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.4 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1. VADER is represented by a solid black bar with an accuracy of approximately 0.70. TextBlob is shown with a diagonally striped bar, also achieving roughly 0.70 accuracy. ChatGPT, depicted by a solid green bar, significantly outperforms the others with an accuracy of approximately 0.95. A legend in the upper right corner identifies each algorithm by its corresponding bar pattern and color. The chart visually emphasizes ChatGPT’s superior performance, with its bar reaching near the top of the scale, while VADER and TextBlob show comparable, lower accuracy levels. The background includes light gray dashed gridlines to aid in value estimation.
